assets.name: stone
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single flat production voxel game tile at 32x32 logical pixels enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Input images are STYLE and BASE STONE references only; do not copy their copper or cyan inclusions. A seamless neutral gray stone texture matching the base rock around the inclusions in the two reference ore textures. Remove ALL mineral inclusions: ONLY stone. Fine irregular compact mottled gray patches and very subtle cracks, quieter contrast than the ores. No cobblestone outlines, no brown tint, no concentric swirls, no large rocks. Restrained grayscale pixel-art palette, crisp square pixels, same detail scale as references. Fill the whole square canvas edge to edge, seamless tileable diffuse albedo, flat lighting, no scene, no perspective, no borders, no words, no watermark, no transparent regions. Will be downsampled to exactly32x32.
